summary: This Form 8-K filing by JLL Income Property Trust, Inc. announces a public earnings call scheduled for May 13, 2026, to review first quarter 2026 operating and financial results. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring.
